summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO 22000 Lead Auditor exam with five days of FSMS audit training, practical case-study exercises, and exam simulation.
audienceIntro: ISO 22000 Lead Auditor training is intended for professionals who work with food safety management systems and need to plan, perform, lead, or follow up on FSMS audits.
prerequisites: To participate, you need a fundamental understanding of food safety concepts and comprehensive knowledge of FSMS audit principles. These are course prerequisites; PECB Certified ISO 22000 Lead Auditor certification also requires passing the exam, five years of professional experience including two years in food safety management, 300 hours of audit activities, and signing the PECB Code of Ethics.
